On December 12, 2025, in Shanghai, China, the GDPS 2025 Global Developer Pioneer Conference and International Embodied Intelligence Skills Competition will officially commence. If the February Global Developer Pioneer Conference showcased a "blooming of a hundred flowers" in software algorithms, then this year-end GDPS event is dedicated to delivering the "abundant fruits" of hardware implementation. Promises about intelligence made in spring will yield answers about embodiment by year's end. Here, it is not the calendar seasons that are followed, but the cycle of innovation—spring blossoms bring autumn harvests, and implementation reigns supreme. As the world's first top-tier competition in embodied intelligence to fully align with the "WorldSkills" standards, this is not just a contest of technology but the "ultimate test" to verify whether silicon-based life can truly integrate into human production and daily life. If 2023 was the "awakening moment" for large models and 2024 the "trial year" for AI applications, then in 2025, we will witness the full explosion of "physical intelligence" here. Estamos a punto de presenciar una materialización industrial que abarcará las cuatro estaciones. excerpt_i18n.en: By the second half of 2025, AI is driving storage demand at an unprecedented pace. According to Leifeng Wang, Q4 storage chip prices have shown a comprehensive upward trend, with the industry widely anticipating a large-scale release of storage demand from Q4 to Q2 of the following year. However, the current capacity expansion across the supply chain struggles to keep pace with demand growth, compounded by soaring storage medium costs, leading to a thought-provoking divergence: on one hand, customers face a shortage of memory modules, while on the other, the market's pricing system descends into chaos—some second-tier storage manufacturers, convinced prices will continue to rise, have even halted external quotes, temporarily arranged employee leave, and opted to stockpile goods to capitalize on larger price gaps. Despite this, in AI storage procurement decisions, memory efficiency remains the top priority, with cost factors relegated to second or even third place. As most industry players welcome the price surge, Sugon has stepped forward to temper the enthusiasm, stating their desire to call for a more rational and healthier, controlled development of the industry, as expressed by Zhang Xinfeng, Vice President of Sugon Storage. Así, surge una situación paradójica: por un lado, los clientes enfrentan dificultades para conseguir módulos de memoria; por otro, el sistema de precios del mercado se ha vuelto caótico, con fabricantes de segunda línea que, convencidos de que los precios seguirán subiendo, incluso han suspendido temporalmente las cotizaciones, han dado vacaciones a empleados y optan por esperar.
